newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on blue chips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dropped at the close on Friday amid position-squaring ahead of the Saturday-Sunday weekend, dealers said.
They said falling prices of global depositary receipts of Hub Power and PTCL abroad prompted individuals to unload expensive blue chips.
The Karachi 100-share index fell 25.50 points, or 1.50 percent, to close at 1,669.23 with 207 losers and 61 gainers.
Citicorp Investment Bank fell 2.75 rupees to 37.75 and Engro Chemicals 2.0 to 183. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
